temporal_projection.tie_break: minimum total absolute change then earliest lexicographic schedule

phase: Eight known development cases x two new seeds. User text unchanged; typed context availability and explicit clock projection are new protocol components.
primary: Every execution plan must satisfy the unchanged schedule and fact requirements. Report raw validity separately, every shifted time, and maximum 10-minute displacement. Non-time errors are not projected. Explicit matched obligation and commute times remain fixed. Never invent or remove activities, alter anchors, prices, or evidence.
review: A verbatim span must be related to the chosen action, with material unsupported causal claims rejected. The projection only handles 20-minute spacing, not factual truth, opening hours, travel feasibility or policy effects.
selection: No empirical policy direction/magnitude targets. This is a deterministic repair protocol, openly reported, not an unaided first-response success or prompt-only ablation. Keep all raw attempts and failed paths.
prohibitions: P010 immutable; P015 not run; no hidden retry, no criteria relaxation, no policy-specific output target. Unused 24-person confirmation remains untouched.
